title: Heterogeneous slab benchmarking and cost-per-token probe across A10/L4/A100/H100
creator: Maya R. Thompson
description: Run a coordinated benchmark suite that evaluates tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cost-per-token across a heterogeneous slab matrix (A10, L4, A100, H100) using realistic mixed workloads. This ticket creates a repeatable harness, defines baselines and alert thresholds for p95 regressions, and produces a cost synthesis report suitable for the pricing and capacity teams. The goal is to quantify trade-offs from batching, KV cache hits, quantization variants (fp16/int8), and multi-instance concurrency for both steady-state and bursty traffic patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Stable harness that runs reproducibly in CI and on perf clusters for all four GPU types
Comprehensive CSV/Parquet output with tokens/sec, p50/p90/p95/p99, GPU utilization, batch size distribution, and effective cost-per-token in USD
Regression detector pipeline that runs nightly and alerts when p95 increases >7% relative to a 30-day rolling baseline
Cost synthesis doc with per-GPU marginal cost, recommended model quantization profile per workload, and suggested autoscale knobs for Dedicated
Stakeholder review session held and sign-off from Product and Finance
test_plan: 1) Implement harness (k8s job) that can schedule identical synthetic sessions to A10, L4, A100, H100 clusters. 2) Workloads: chat-like multi-turn (avg len 120 tokens), completion-heavy long-form (avg len 1024), and embeddings burst (1000 short requests). 3) For each workload, sweep batch sizes {1,4,8,16,32}, KV cache enabled/disabled, quantization profiles {fp16, int8-small, int8-aggressive}. 4) Run 3 warmup runs then 12 steady runs to collect distribution. 5) Store artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/hetero_slab/2026-03-*.parquet. 6) Run regression detector and upload dashboards to the perf Grafana folder.
run_schedule: Initial matrix runs on perf-odd week nodes (2026-03-03 to 2026-03-07). Repeat nightly incremental sweeps (smoke) and weekly full matrix on dedicated perf clusters.
decisions: Primary baseline will use fp16 + KV cache enabled because it reflects most customer defaults
Quantization sweep limited to two int8 profiles to control matrix size and focus on practicality
Nightly regression threshold for p95 set at 7% based on ROI of alerts vs noise observed in prior runs
Use spot-derived cost model with a conservative 1.25 factor to map to committed pricing for Dedicated recommendations
implementation_notes: Harness implemented as a declarative k8s Job template + helm chart. Uses load-generator service that simulates multi-tenant arrival patterns with Poisson burst mode. Aggregator writes metrics to Prometheus via pushgateway and to S3 as Parquet. Regression detector uses a 30-day rolling baseline computed in BigQuery and triggers PagerDuty if anomaly persists for 2 consecutive nightly runs.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: L4 cluster has noisy neighbors causing p95 spikes. Mitigation: run isolated dedicated slots for comparison and use QoS labels to pin pods.
Risk: Cost mapping from spot to committed is inaccurate. Mitigation: run a calibration subset on reserved-cost instances and adjust factor; include error bars in report.
Risk: KV cache warmup skews short-run latency. Mitigation: enforce longer warmup window and report cold vs warm metrics separately.
